description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'html_options' that generates HTML <option> tags for select elements, allowing customization with parameters such as name, options, values, selected items, and output. It includes internal helper functions for constructing option outputs and groups.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Generates a string of HTML <option> tags based on provided parameters, optionally wrapping them in a <select> element with a specified name.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Creates an individual <option> tag or an <optgroup> if the value is an array, marking options as selected when appropriate.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optgroup
methods.description: Generates an <optgroup> tag with nested options.
